## Checklist

- [ ] Permission to contribute under the applicable terms is recorded.
- [ ] Existing behavior, tests and release records are preserved.
- [ ] Both Python suites, UI tests, validation and public checks pass.
- [ ] Formula/schema changes are explicitly documented and versioned.
- [ ] Counterevidence, missing values and fictional labels remain visible.
- [ ] No credentials, client records, raw live archives or scratch files are included.
- [ ] Security and approval changes have appropriate negative tests.
- [ ] No unverifiable certification, calibration or accuracy claims were added.
